<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Policy and Regulatory Milestones:</strong> The RBI maintained the repo rate and projected 6.9% GDP growth, while the NSE cleared a major IPO hurdle by settling long-standing regulatory cases with SEBI for ₹1,491 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty extended gains for a third consecutive day, supported by robust FII inflows and strong Q1 earnings from Bajaj Finance, despite mixed performance in the IT sector.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Fiscal Position:</strong> India’s fiscal deficit for the April-June quarter reached ₹3.08 lakh crore, accounting for 18.2% of the full-year target for FY27.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQREIxRkdxUmtxeGE0d3pfNWF6d19sZThJMlkydWlHVWFEdmxIWGtMenZiY3lLSUp5dF9zVjNzYkV6Snpfb0E3RXA3Nkl6THBSdHNNb1Znc0NGSUZhY1d6YlVWZ1FJOHZJZGFEamFtZG9CeENpeUx2cUdsVDA5VF9rT3g0eHc4cDlrbWk3VUxzY001a1gwcGlFLS1IUXc2UUtCcjFqUHBYRHVmUl9WZklvckRB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>
